description: E3 / paper Fig. 5: Fourier coefficients c_0..c_5 of 100 random L = 1 models with RX on 4 parallel qubits and <Z_0> (reference notebook settings, LOG.md D3). Circuit A = StronglyEntanglingLayers, Circuit B = BasicEntanglerLayers (RX + CNOT ring), each with l = 1 and l = 5 ansatz layers, plus the notebook's 'no unitary' control. Angles from U[0, 2 pi); coefficients from rfft on 11 points of [0, 2 pi).
